hypotheses.reasoning: POST /v1/notify 503s at api-gateway are downstream of notification-svc returning 503 because template-svc render calls fail (notification-svc #3274, #3372). template-svc's failures trace to its calls to the third-party email provider api.mailer.example, which began failing at about 05:58:56 (#2926 first upstream 503; #2978 no response within 10s). The provider then returned 503 (#3009) and read timeouts after 10s (#3104). template-svc's circuit breaker opened at 06:00:31 (#3142), and half-open probes kept failing (#3337, #3819), so renders fail fast with 'circuit open'. Our own services (DB, redis, auth) show no errors. The mix of 503s and hangs leaves a dependency_timeout reading equally plausible.

Alternative reading: template-svc's HTTP client to api.mailer.example hangs (10s read timeouts, 'no response within 10s'), saturating template-svc and cascading to notification-svc and the gateway's 503s. Same lines as above; the timeouts favor this framing over a clean outage.

verdict.recommendedAction: Treat the email provider (api.mailer.example) as the origin: confirm its status and fail over to a secondary mail provider, or queue notifications for later retry. Lower template-svc's 10s HTTP timeout so calls fail fast, and tune the circuit breaker so notification-svc degrades gracefully. Separately, audit-consumer is stuck on msg-567751 at audit.events partition 7 offset 718634 (NUL byte in JSON, #2993, #3280), causing lag to grow past 5000 messages; dead-letter or skip that message. Analytics-forwarder 429s (#2966) are a secondary issue.
